fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects attempts to use system dialog prompts to capture user credentials
fields.name: GUI Input Capture - macOS
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/osascript" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "-e" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "display" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "dialog" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "answer") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "admin" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "administrator" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "authenticate" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "authentication" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "credentials" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "pass" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "password" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "unlock")))
